policy: Frozen references; do not overwrite accepted files.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: frozen Phase 2 full-body character modeling reference for an original browser game, Athen Hill, a 2001 sci-fi MMO homage city slice.
Primary request: Create one original male player colonist character, three-quarter view in a relaxed near A-pose, both arms slightly away from torso, empty open hands, every finger unobstructed, both boots and entire head visible with ample margins. Lean natural 1.8 m human proportions, late twenties, swept-back brown hair, short full brown beard, rugged grounded face. The character is a practical new colonist wearing a scuffed dark olive and gunmetal work jacket over a charcoal undershirt, only ONE salvaged bevelled shoulder pad, canvas cargo pants, a utility belt with two simple worn pouches, fingerless gloves, sturdy dusty boots, and one cheap small cyan wrist terminal. The jacket and cloth carry most of the silhouette; simple layered construction, no weapons.
Scene/backdrop: Plain softly textured warm grey-beige modeling backdrop and a strip of dry pale stone tile underfoot. No busy scenery. Feet firmly grounded with soft long cast shadow.
Style/medium: Cohesive authored videogame character concept, believable painted texture detail and chunky practical shapes, slightly soft dusty texture finish inspired by early-2000s science-fiction games, readable real-time mesh construction. Not a plastic toy and not a photographic actor.
Lighting/mood: Warm low late-afternoon sunlight from upper-left, muted blue-grey ambient fill, physical restrained contrast, same dusty golden-hour light as a desert city plaza.
Color palette: Sand stone #C4A574, dust #B8956A, gunmetal #3A4149, muted olive #4A5A32, tiny cyan #3EC7C2 on wrist screen only. Dusty fabric and browned leather, high roughness painted metal.
Composition/framing: A single full-body three-quarter standing figure, portrait 2:3, camera near chest height, minimal perspective distortion, natural leg separation, face and hands readable, full body occupies about 80% of image height. This is a sculpting/rigging design reference, not an action poster.
Constraints: One character only. Entire boots and hands visible. Original design, no logos, no symbols from existing franchises, no labels, no watermark, no armor suit, no helmet, no cape, no body-wide glowing stripes, no shiny chrome, no rain, no cyberpunk neon, no depth-of-field blur on the character.

sources.role: Visually inspected style, palette, and light reference; described in prompt.
Visually inspected male grooming and face direction; simplified to practical workwear per AGENTS.md.
Visually inspected broad character identity and proportions; full armor intentionally omitted per written spec.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: frozen Phase 2 full-body vendor character and compact stall reference for the original browser game Athen Hill, a 2001 sci-fi MMO homage city slice.
Primary request: One original human vendor named Mira, a lean adult woman with short tied-back dark brown hair, weathered friendly face, natural realistic 1.75 m proportions. She uses the same practical colonist character kit as a lean male colonist in a scuffed olive work jacket, charcoal undershirt, canvas cargo trousers, simple belt pouches, fingerless gloves and sturdy boots. Her distinguishing outfit variant has a faded oxblood red #8B2E2E rolled-sleeve work shirt and a worn brown canvas waist apron with two stitched tool pockets over dusty olive cargo trousers; one small cheap cyan wrist terminal and simple utility belt. Cloth-led simple silhouette, economical game-ready construction, no armor suit or elaborate accessories.
Scene/backdrop: Mira stands fully in view beside, not behind, her small basic general supplies stall, a waist-high bevelled gunmetal counter on a pale sandstone shop porch. A simple brown water flask with a metal cap and a compact ivory-and-muted-red medkit case are clearly visible on the counter. Behind is a shallow, dark, recessed stone-and-metal shop opening and a faded red cloth awning edge; otherwise uncluttered. No other people.
Style/medium: Cohesive authored videogame character concept with slightly soft painted dusty textures, realistic anatomy, chunky early-2000s science-fiction construction and restrained detailed wear. Preserve matte cloth, rough leather, scuffed stone and painted dark metal. Not anime, not a toy, not a photographic actor.
Lighting/mood: Warm late-afternoon sunlight from upper-left with gentle blue-grey ambient fill; same dry golden-hour desert-city mood as a raised ancient-tree plaza. Physical warm light, soft long shadows, readable face.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2. Full body is visible from head to both boots with generous margins; figure about 82% of image height. Three-quarter view in relaxed near A-pose, arms slightly away from torso, empty relaxed hands clearly visible with natural separated fingers. The entire legs and boots remain unobstructed. Vendor occupies center-left, compact flask/medkit counter to her side on the right. Camera near chest height and minimal perspective distortion. Useful for modeling a character variant plus a simple stall kit.
Color palette: Sandstone #C4A574, dust haze #B8956A, gunmetal #3A4149, plinth #8B7A63, faded oxblood cloth #8B2E2E, small cyan #3EC7C2 terminal display only.
Constraints: One full-body character and one shallow basic supplies stall only. Original design. No text, no signage lettering, no logos, no existing franchise marks, no weapons, no helmet, no cape, no shiny chrome, no glossy wet pavement, no night, no rain, no neon strips, no giant futuristic towers, no blur on the character, no crops of hands or feet.

sources.role: Visually inspected sandstone, gunmetal, faded red awning, and warm sunlight style.
Prior generated and visually inspected practical colonist kit; translated in prompt into vendor variant.
